name: Soul Order Online
summary:
Soul Order Online was a dark fantasy MMORPG set in a world divided by a spiritual conflict between two main factions: Dark Land and Glory. Players chose a side in this war and took on the role of combatants capable of manipulating spiritual energy to develop distinct abilities and combat styles.

The game featured character progression based on specializations, open-world exploration, instanced dungeons, and PvP modes centered on faction-based conflict.
